plan.notes: Source: St. Joseph's College of Nursing official curriculum page (sjhcon.edu/curriculum/), 'FIRST YEAR - FIRST SEMESTER' through 'SECOND YEAR - SECOND SEMESTER', transcribed exactly: four semesters (19/17/16/16) = 68 credits total. The school's catalog confirms graduates receive the Associate in Applied Science degree with a major in nursing (68 credits: 41 specialized nursing + 27 liberal arts and sciences). Liberal arts/science courses marked * are offered at St. Joseph's or at affiliate Le Moyne College; PHL 346 (**) is a Le Moyne College course taught at SJCON. SOC 101 row reads 'Introductory Sociology or Intro to Anthropology' (3 cr): transcribed as a choice course with the first-listed option. The school's catalog notes the curriculum is continually updated and refers to this page for the current curriculum plan; the archived 2020-2021 curriculum PDF shows the same 68-credit structure. Prerequisite detail not published on the curriculum page; semester order is as published. Evening/Weekend option (18-month, nursing courses only) was not separately collected. No courses invented.
